verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents a token-authenticated REST API that any application can call without the UI, including creating candidates and offers and listing candidates. That allows scripted, non-interactive automation, but nothing is documented specifically for headless or CI use. Missing for 10: official CLI or SDK, CI/pipeline usage guidance, machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), sandbox or test environment for safe CI runs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: a client (any application that would like to use the API) needs to authenticate first with a header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
